content.short: NFT Ideation is an NFT project designed to help community members create new NFT use cases and have them funded by the community pool.
content.description: NFT Ideation launches the People of History NFTs, a collection of 6,666 historical figures from the collective memory that also serve as access keys to the Innovation Lab. NFT owners have the opportunity to create new types of NFT use cases, fund them through the community pool and realize them through the NFT Ideation Network.
